# Segmented control (`segmented-control`)

Pill radio group for a few options.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSegmentedControl` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/segmentedControl.d.ts`): `.mh-segmented`: a pill radio group for a few options. Each segment is a native radio under its visible face, so arrow keys move the selection and Tab enters on the chosen one.

```ts
export function createSegmentedControl(options: SegmentedControlOptions): SegmentedControlHandle;

export interface SegmentedControlOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the group. */
  label: string;
  options: readonly SegmentOption[];
  value?: string;
  name?: string;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium';
  /** Stretch to the container, segments sharing the width. */
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface SegmentedControlHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  inputs: HTMLInputElement[];
  getValue(): string | undefined;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSegmentedControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const range = createSegmentedControl({
  label: 'Energy range',
  value: 'week',
  options: [
    { value: 'day', label: 'Day' },
    { value: 'week', label: 'Week' },
    { value: 'month', label: 'Month' },
  ],
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = `Showing the last ${value}`),
});

document.body.append(range.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SegmentedControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const RANGES = [
  { value: 'day', label: 'Day' },
  { value: 'week', label: 'Week' },
  { value: 'month', label: 'Month' },
];

export function SegmentedControlExample() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState('week');
  return (
    <SegmentedControl label="Energy range" options={RANGES} value={range} onChange={(value) => setRange(value)} />
  );
}
```
